versions.changelog:
Initial release of plc-job-scraper.

- Automates searching for PLC, automation, and SCADA job listings from major job boards such as LinkedIn, Indeed, and Glassdoor.
- Supports configuration of job boards, keywords, locations, and job types via environment variables.
- Outputs results in JSON or CSV format with comprehensive job fields (title, company, location, etc.).
- Provides tools for exporting results to CSV or Google Sheets.
- Includes guidance on automation, notifications (e.g., Telegram), proxy rotation, and filtering.
